name: Jehosheba
bio: Jehosheba, daughter of King Jehoram (Joram) and sister of Ahaziah, saved the royal line of Judah from extinction. When Athaliah seized the throne after Ahaziah's death and set about destroying all the royal heirs, Jehosheba stole away her infant nephew Joash from among the king's sons being slain and hid him with his nurse in a bedroom, keeping him safe from Athaliah. She kept him hidden in the temple of the LORD for six years while Athaliah reigned (2 Kings 11:1-3).
